question: List, in chronological order, the events in which the service pool of these trainsets was set up or rearranged, among the dated events in the timeline.
why_needs_multiple: Năm lần thay đổi cấu hình phục vụ khác nhau của đội tàu; cần đủ cả năm theo thứ tự.
criterion: a dated setup or rearrangement of the TEE service pool for these trainsets

gold_events.text: Five sets entered four-day TEE service pool, which ran until 1964.
L'Oiseau Bleu service went permanently to loco-hauled Inox coaches.
L'Etoile du Nord also went loco-hauled; pool became a three-day circuit.
L'Arbalete service became loco-hauled Inox coaches; filling-in turn changed.
Three-day pool ended after one trainset was written off; four sets kept for Edelweiss.

question: Among the dated events, which switch of a TEE service from the diesel trainsets to locomotive-hauled Inox coaches came last?
why_needs_multiple: Phải so sánh ba lần chuyển sang toa Inox kéo bằng đầu máy để xác định lần muộn nhất.
criterion: a TEE service switching from the diesel trainsets to locomotive-hauled Inox coaches

gold_events.text: L'Etoile du Nord also went loco-hauled; pool became a three-day circuit.
L'Arbalete service became loco-hauled Inox coaches; filling-in turn changed.

question: How many calendar years passed from the year the five trainsets entered the four-day TEE service pool to the year their last day in TEE service occurred?
why_needs_multiple: Cần hai mốc có ngày xác định (bắt đầu và kết thúc phục vụ TEE) để tính khoảng cách theo năm.
criterion: the start of the four-day service pool and the last day of the sets in TEE service
